730:t_1:84.en:
$n
「If I lose, I'll be putting you in danger, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

730:t_1:85.en:
$n
「So let's make sure we win, together.」

730:t_1:87.en:
$$ランド$$
(Just wait, $$アサキム$$. We have no doubts anymore.)

730:t_1:88.en:
$$セツコ$$
(I will end every last tie between us.)

730:t_2:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I can't sense any living presence here...」

730:t_2:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It is not merely that there are no animals... I do not think there are even plants or microorganisms.」

730:t_2:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「Your intuition is right, Captain. I've tested the air and soil a little, and I can't even find bacteria.」

730:t_2:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That's not all... I can't sense any of the will of matter we learned about when we achieved $$真化融合$$, either.」

730:t_2:8.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「Did the planet die because all its $$次元力|lc$$ was used up, like $$インサラウム$$?」

730:t_2:9.en:
$$トライア$$
「I think the $$御使い$$s reshaped this planet into a place like this, rather than that happening to it.」

730:t_2:11.en:
$$刹那$$
「...They said all life fused when they were reborn as higher-dimensional beings...」

730:t_2:12.en:
$$タケル$$
「That 'all life' apparently includes animals, plants, microorganisms... and matter itself.」

730:t_2:13.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So once all life became one, this became a lifeless planet.」

730:t_2:14.en:
$$勝平$$
「I... thought the universe's truth would be something happier. But looking at this planet, I can't think that anymore.」

730:t_2:15.en:
$$アルト$$
「Neither can I. It feels like their fusion forcibly gathered all life together.」

730:t_2:16.en:
$$アマタ$$
「So this is a lifeless planet...」

730:t_2:17.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「When you think of it that way, those stones around us... look just like graves...」

730:t_3:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Life repeats its cycle of formation, existence, destruction, and emptiness... In that cycle, I seem to have become too deeply involved with you...」

730:t_3:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Loving you probably made this fate inevitable for me.」

730:t_3:8.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I will not apologize, $$セツコ$$. I only fought for myself.」

730:t_3:9.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I understand. But I will not forgive you.」

730:t_3:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's fine, $$セツコ$$. We'll make him take responsibility.」

730:t_3:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Since you've admitted defeat, we can take that to mean you'll help us, right?」

730:t_3:12.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I will help you strictly to defeat the $$御使い$$s.」

730:t_3:13.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Understood, $$アサキム$$... I will postpone our reckoning until then.」

730:t_3:15.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$... So you did understand what life means.」

730:t_3:17.en:
$$アサキム$$
「What do you want now, $$サクリファイ$$?」

730:t_3:18.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「I came to apologize to you.」

730:t_3:19.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「I wish to apologize to atone, however little, for what I did to you, rather than to soothe my own sorrow.」

730:t_3:20.en:
$$クロウ$$
「An $$御使い$$ is... bowing her head...?」

730:t_3:22.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Your battle with $$アサキム$$ reminded me of the meaning of finite life and its beauty.」

730:t_3:23.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「That is something precious we discarded 120 million years ago.」

730:t_3:25.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「I admit it. I... regret becoming an $$御使い$$.」

730:t_3:26.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Humans cannot become gods... We had no right to obtain eternity...」

730:t_4:4.en:
$$イザベル$$
「...To everyone across the world. Voting under the $$新地球連邦政府$$'s new system will begin shortly.」

730:t_4:5.en:
$$イザベル$$
「This is a crucial vote that will determine the world's course... and humanity's future. Please watch this broadcast with that in mind.」

730:t_4:6.en:
$$グエン$$
「...That concludes all the information about our enemies obtained from $$キング$$, the highest authority of $$クロノ$$.」

730:t_4:11.en:
$$大統領$$
「To everyone who can hear my voice... This matter has been proposed as the first of the $$新地球連邦政府$$'s most important issues for debate.」

730:t_4:12.en:
$$大統領$$
「This system uses the ley lines and $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ to incorporate the opinions of everyone participating in the debate... We now face the need to use it.」

730:t_4:13.en:
$$大統領$$
「We will now take the vote. Consider the information from Lord $$グエン$$ and $$サイデリアル$$, and decide for yourselves whether to approve or reject it.」

730:t_4:14.en:
$$大統領$$
「The GN particles and ley lines covering the entire Earth Sphere will immediately reflect your wishes in the vote.」

730:t_4:15.en:
$$アーミア$$
「The system for tallying the participants' quantum brainwaves is also functioning properly.」

730:t_4:16.en:
$$大統領$$
「Then we will vote in thirty seconds. Everyone, please prepare.」

730:t_4:23.en:
$$大統領$$
「Now, let us take the vo...」

730:t_4:24.en:
$$アーミア$$
「All systems are operating normally. The results are coming in.」

730:t_4:25.en:
$$大統領$$
「...Then this proposal passes by an overwhelming majority.」

730:t_4:26.en:
$$大統領$$
「Accordingly, once all forces are in position, we will deactivate $$スヴェル$$, the dimensional barrier defending Earth.」

730:t_10:4.en:
$$ランド$$
(We've come this far, and we won't hesitate... We won't let them do whatever they please with you any longer.)

730:t_10:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
(We will rescue you from the $$御使い$$s, so that we can settle things between us as well.)

730:t_10:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Now that we've made up our minds, all that's left is to act.」

730:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It seems $$セツコ$$ and $$ランド$$ each sorted out their feelings through their battle with $$アサキム$$.」

730:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The result is these 100 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s. I shall add them to the team's stock.」

730:t_10:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Now $n is the only one left...」

730:t_10:11.en:
$$エスター$$
「Is he going to be OK...?」

730:t_10:12.en:
$$メール$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ is with him, but...」

730:t_10:13.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't worry. He's among the very best at surviving.」
